name: wildcard-permitted-cross-subtree-invalid
description: A wildcard SAN in a sibling subtree (*.bar.example.com) is not permitted by a constraint on a different sibling (foo.example.com).
references: Go name_constraints_test "cross include should not match"
notes: RFC 5280 does not define wildcard SAN semantics; this targets Go's application DNS-ID name-constraint behavior.
